messages:
Anna (Orchid): Hi team — procurement went back and wants a single PO that covers Hosted + Dedicated seats, and they require net60. Also need our vendor W-9 and vendor code to put on the PO. Can we get an updated invoice/quote and a DocuSign timeline?
Emma (CS): Thanks Anna — we can do single PO. Quick Q: final headcount and term length? 12mo vs 9mo affects discount.
Anna (Orchid): Prefer 9 months if that helps timing. Headcount is 35 seats (25 hosted, 10 dedicated).
Luis (Sales): 9mo @ 35 seats — I can preserve ~8% on-hosted / 12% dedicated commit discount. Will reprice and send revised quote.
Maya (Finance): Net60 is okay provided we have the customer's PO and correct remit address. Also need vendor W-9 and Redwood vendor code — if Procurement insists on a code, we may need to run them through our vendor onboarding (2–3 business days).
Oliver (Ops): For the Dedicated seats, confirm if they want a single invoice or split (we can consolidate to one invoice that references both SKUs). If they want separate chargebacks to different cost centers, we'll need split invoicing.
Anna (Orchid): One consolidated invoice is best. Remit and tax info: Orchid Tech LLC, 12 Beacon St, Boston MA — VAT/QST not applicable (US).
Emma (CS): Noted. Luis — can you include consolidated invoice format on the quote? Maya — can we provide a Redwood vendor code or an interim identifier so Procurement can create the PO now?
Luis (Sales): Yep, I'll annotate the quote with a consolidated invoice example and line that shows seat split.
Maya (Finance): We don't have an active vendor code for Orchid in our system. I can issue a temporary reference like "RWI-PT-XXXXX" but final vendor code requires onboarding. If Procurement can accept the temporary ref on the PO we'll be fine.
Anna (Orchid): Procurement asked for a PO number now. I'll generate one on our side: `PO: ORCH-2026-00123` — can you reference that on the DocuSign and invoice? Also, is there a way to get DocuSign sent this afternoon?
Emma (CS): I'll bundle the revised quote + SOW and push DocuSign by EOD. Need Luis's updated pricing and Maya's temp vendor ref to put into the SOW/contract.
Luis (Sales): Pricing attached to the quote I'm uploading to the thread (link in DM). Using PO ORCH-2026-00123 and 9mo term.
Maya (Finance): Use temp ref `RWI-PT-32109` on contract and invoice fields. Finance confirms net60, remit to Redwood Inference, 100 Market St, SF CA.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x9f4a sent to Anna (Orchid) — 1 signature required. https://docusign.example/envelope/0x9f4a
Anna (Orchid): Got the envelope link — thanks. I'll route to procurement for signature.
Emma (CS): Great. One ask from Legal: Procurement asked about liability cap and data handling annex — please confirm if Orchid needs any redlines.
Anna (Orchid): No legal redlines on our side, standard annex is fine.
Oliver (Ops): FYI when Dedicated goes live we'll need a billing contact for usage metering; please provide a monitoring contact email to avoid oncall noise.
Anna (Orchid): Use billing@orchid-tech.com and eng-ops@orchid-tech.com for monitoring.
Luis (Sales): :thumbsup:
Emma (CS): I'll follow up once DocuSign is fully signed and send the final invoice schedule. If anything delays vendor onboarding we'll ping procurement to accept the temp ref.
Anna (Orchid): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
